evidence: Modifies shared utilities in src/util/expected.h, src/compat/byteswap.h, and src/util/types.h to retire in-tree polyfills in favor of standard C++23 types.
rationale: Retiring in-tree polyfills like `util::Expected` for `std::expected` and standard byteswap simplifies core utility headers and reduces custom boilerplate. While beneficial for long-term maintenance, it is an internal developer cleanup that can be deferred without user-facing consequence.
